German or otherlanguages are a plus.- You demonstrate an international mindsetand are open to international travel, and working in a diverse team.Whilecommitment to our job improves performance, growth happens when we stretchbeyond our comfort zone. jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Büro- und BetriebsassistentStellenbeschreibung:LRT Automotive GmbH is a family-run, medium-sized production company based near Heidelberg and has been successfully operating in the European aftermarket since 1998.We specialise in the manufacture of high-quality exhaust system components, including exhaustmanifolds, catalytic converters, diesel particulate filters and flexible pipes – and supply distributors, wholesalers and workshops throughout Europe.Characterized by internal development expertise and long-term customer relationships, we stand for quality, technical reliability and speed.Since 2021, we have also been expanding into electromobility and developing innovative EV charging solutions that combine high-quality hardware with intelligent software.From combustion to electrification – LRT stands for performance that moves Europe.We are looking for a reliable, structured and proactive personality to support our team at the Walldorf site.Location: Walldorf, Germany (local)Full-timeLanguages: German (native speaker) & fluent EnglishYour tasks:• General office and administrative tasks• Support in operational purchasing and ordering• Communication with suppliers and customers• Internal coordination between departments• Support of management in day-to-day businessYour profile:• German at native speaker level is mandatory• Very good knowledge of• Structured, reliable and independent way of• Organizational talent and strong communication skills• Experience in administration, operations, purchasing or customer service is an advantage

KLIFOVET GmbH, part of the Argenta Group, is a globally recognized supplier in the veterinary and feed sector based in Munich. We have made it our mission to competently accompany customers from the idea, through development, to approval and beyond. The service for our customers determines our actions. Since our founding in 1997, we have been awarded three times as the best service provider and the best contract research organization internationally.About the roleThe commercial project assistant role is a great opportunity to gain development within a dynamic and diverse team. Some of the key tasks you will be involved with are:- Supporting project managers in the preparation and execution of clinical trials- Procurement of study materials and office supplies- Support of the departments in the area of shipping and logistics- Support for data maintenance and data collection- Documentation and archiving of study documents- Labelling, dispensing, and administration of study medication- First point of contact for customers and service providers on site and by telephone- General office activities and support of in-house administrative processesAbout youBy nature, you are a positive team player, embracing change and flexibility ensuring you are agile to meet the business demands.  You are reliable, and ambitious to learn new skills achieving the best you can in support of your team.Experience and key skills- A completed commercial apprenticeship or an apprenticeship in the pharmaceutical/medical field- Solid knowledge in the use of MS Office programs- Interest and curiosity to familiarize yourself with new tasks and areas of knowledge- Independent, reliable and bring structure to your tasks- Excellent German and English language skills, both written and verbal,  other foreign language skills are an advantage- Customer-oriented, confident and positive appearance as well as open to having fun working in a teamWe offer you a detailed introduction to your field of work, an independent, challenging and varied job, modern work equipment, family-friendly working hours, regular training and further education and a positive and collegial team in an appealing ambience in Munich.If this sounds like an interesting role to you and you are looking for a new opportunity we would love to hear from you.  Please apply for this role via www.argentaglobal.com/careers

Job Title: Development Engineer MEMS Process Technology (f/m/div.)\n\nJob Description:Join the MEMS team! Together we shape the future of MEMS sensors and enable innovative automotive, consumer and industrial applications.• Both conceptually and directly inside the cleanroom and laboratory, you develop advanced wafer processes for manufacturing high-end micromechanical products.• You evaluate novel materials and manufacturing methods regarding technical feasibility and economic viability.• In close alignment with demanding international customers, you drive technological development goals forward to meet tight schedules reliably.• Cross-functional collaboration between development and production is guided by you to transition prototype designs smoothly into series production.• Alongside thorough quality assessments and process releases, you coordinate joint projects with external research institutes for fundamental technology development.Qualifications:• Education: completed university degree in engineering, natural sciences, physics, chemistry, materials science, or a comparable discipline; a PhD is an advantage• Experience and Know-how: several years of professional experience in developing semiconductor or MEMS technologies; profound expertise in sensor technology, micromechanics, and semiconductor processing including relevant analytical methods; deep understanding of physical principles; demonstrated practice in statistical methods and automated data analysis• Personality and Working Style: you find it easy to pursue ambitious goals with perseverance, discover creative approaches, navigate tight timelines with focus, make sound decisions quickly, and advocate technical viewpoints persuasively across all interfaces• Work Environment: willingness to work regularly within the cleanroom and laboratory environment• Enthusiasm: genuine curiosity for pioneering technologies and exploring uncharted fields of application• Languages: highly proficient English and German language skills in speech and writingIn accordance with our regulations, the gross annual salary for this position is at least 88.000 EUR for a 35h week (for a full year of employment and fulfillment of the eligibility requirements based on collective agreements) in the case of a comprehensive execution of job requirements. We will be happy to discuss further details of our remuneration package, as well as (remuneration) development opportunities, with you during the application process.Application deadline up to and including 1th of november 2026.Additional Information:We offer flexible working models: from various part-time options to mobile working and job sharing. Feel free to contact us.Diversity and inclusion are not just trends for us but are firmly anchored in our corporate culture. As a Failure Analysis Engineer, you’ll make avaluable contribution to development projects by not only pinpointing but alsoanalyzing faults through electrical and physical analyses.
